tasks.short: Design systems, processes or equipment to control or remediate water, air or soil quality.

steps.what: Verify actual contaminant loads, site constraints and environmental design requirements
inputs: actual site and sampling records
actual project design requirements
outputs: engineer-checked environmental design basis

steps.what: Design or supervise design of the actual pollution-control or remediation process and equipment
inputs: engineer-checked environmental design basis
outputs: engineer-chosen candidate process geometry, operating cases and calculation methods

steps.what: Prepare exact design calculations and drawings using native reusable engineering model inputs
inputs: engineer-chosen candidate process geometry, operating cases and calculation methods
engineer-checked environmental design basis
outputs: engineer-checked calculation results and candidate design drawings

steps.what: Validate and approve the complete final environmental engineering design and calculation limitations
inputs: engineer-checked calculation results and candidate design drawings
engineer-checked environmental design basis
outputs: approved final environmental engineering design record

steps.what: Commit the approved final environmental engineering design record
inputs: approved final environmental engineering design record
outputs: saved final environmental engineering design record

tasks.design: Configure native reusable input sets and drawing fields in {ENVIRONMENTAL_ENGINEERING_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER. The engineer establishes the actual design basis and chooses process, geometry and calculation methods; native reuse reduces repeated input preparation. Full design validation and final approval precede a separate record commit; no model chooses remediation equipment.
tasks.previous_blocker: Design cases may repeat manual transfer of checked loads, geometry and operating values.
tasks.enabler_now: Native engineering templates can reuse exact human-chosen input sets across calculations and drawings.
tasks.still_hard: Uncertain contaminant behaviour, physical feasibility and validating the chosen design method.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer judges whether calculated performance is credible for the actual site.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated design input preparation with engineering decisions retained.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: environmental engineering calculation and drawing tools can reuse exact input templates; this configuration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual manual input transfer after existing engineering templates; existing solvers, drawings and runtime earn no saving.

Actual site records supply sample_id, concentration, flow_or_mass_rate, units and site_conditions. s1 checks source validity; s2 captures chosen geometry, operating_case, equation_or_solver and boundary_conditions at full time. s3 retains 12.5 hours for unit, input and calculation checks; missing inputs use manual engineering preparation.
s4 retains full substantive design validation, not merely executable calculations. Final design exists before approval and commit; changes void approval. Same-system commit earns no benefit.
research_questions: Which checked design inputs are still manually transferred after native model templates?

incremental.description: Maintain actual design input and drawing field mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete final validated environmental engineering design record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only repeated input preparation changes: 25 times 50% = 12.5 less 1 upkeep = 11.5. Low halves that benefit: 6.25 less 1 = 5.25.

tasks.short: Assess environmental impacts of land-use projects on air, water or land.

inputs: actual land-use project proposal
actual environmental source records
outputs: engineer-checked land-use impact assessment basis

steps.what: Align actual project footprints and environmental layers using native geographic joins and units
inputs: engineer-checked land-use impact assessment basis
actual project and environmental geographic layers
outputs: engineer-checked receptor, footprint and environmental comparison tables

steps.what: Assess actual air, water and land impacts, uncertainties and feasible mitigation
inputs: engineer-checked receptor, footprint and environmental comparison tables
actual project methods and site context
outputs: engineer land-use impact findings and limitations

steps.what: Write and approve the complete final land-use environmental impact assessment record
inputs: engineer land-use impact findings and limitations
outputs: approved final land-use environmental impact assessment record

steps.what: Save the approved final land-use environmental impact assessment record
inputs: approved final land-use environmental impact assessment record
outputs: saved final land-use environmental assessment

tasks.design: Configure native geographic joins and comparison views in {GIS}, denoted OTHER, over actual project and environmental data. The engineer checks baseline evidence and assesses actual air, water and land impacts personally. The final written assessment is approved before its separate save; no geographic overlap is treated as proof of impact.
tasks.previous_blocker: Project footprints, receptors and environmental observations may be manually aligned repeatedly.
tasks.enabler_now: Native geographic joins can reuse exact coordinates, dates and source versions.
tasks.still_hard: Causation, uncertain baseline quality, cumulative effects and mitigation feasibility.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer decides whether the evidence supports a material environmental impact.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated spatial preparation before human impact assessment.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: geographic systems support native spatial joins and comparison layers; this assessment configuration is proposed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Verify residual spatial alignment after existing geographic workflows; existing overlays and runtime earn no saving.

Actual project and monitoring owners supply layer_id, coordinate_system, observation_date, receptor_id, measured_value and units. s1 retains full baseline and scope checks; s2 retains 12.5 hours for projection, date, unit and coverage checks. Missing compatible layers use manual assessment preparation.
s3 retains full impact judgement and s4 full final writing and approval. Any change voids approval before save. Same-system save earns no benefit. No measured environmental baseline is invented.
research_questions: Which project and receptor alignment remains manual after current geographic layers?

inputs: actual contaminated-site assignment
actual current approved cleanup reference set

inputs: engineer-checked site cleanup references and applicability questions
actual site investigation and sampling findings
outputs: engineer-checked site-specific cleanup conditions

steps.what: Choose justified site cleanup procedures, safeguards and verification requirements
inputs: engineer-checked site-specific cleanup conditions
outputs: engineer-chosen site cleanup advice and limitations

inputs: engineer-chosen site cleanup advice and limitations
outputs: approved final site cleanup advice and exact external recipient

tasks.design: Configure native site-specific reference links in {ENVIRONMENTAL_PROJECT_SYSTEM}, denoted OTHER, and {DOCS}. The engineer assesses actual exposure pathways, chooses procedures and writes complete final site advice personally. Final approval precedes a separate external delivery; no generic procedure is presented as a validated cleanup plan.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current site requirements and approved technical references may be repeatedly retrieved.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project links can retain exact source versions and site scope.
tasks.still_hard: Exposure, heterogeneous contamination, practical safeguards and site-specific applicability.
tasks.human_edge: The engineer judges whether a procedure protects actual people and environmental receptors.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated reference retrieval before human cleanup advice.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: environmental project records can link current technical references; no automated cleanup judgement is claimed.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Observe residual reference retrieval after existing project links; existing search and runtime earn no saving.

Actual reference owners supply reference_id, version, site_scope and requirement_topic. s1 retains 7.5 hours for currency and applicability checks; missing current references are verified manually. Actual sampling owners supply findings, not invented site baselines.

Full exposure assessment, procedure judgement and final writing remain. s4 approves complete final text and exact recipient before delivery; changed advice requires renewed approval. No cleanup completion or external acceptance is inferred.
